environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the Kafka consumer with default security context. The LDAP service account (cn=svc-kafka-consumer) has broad read access across the directory tree including userPassword, ntSecurityDescriptor, and all OUs. Network policy allows unrestricted egress to the LDAP server on port 389. No input validation middleware. Kafka topic ACLs allow any authenticated producer to write to user-sync-events.

config.ldap_service_account_permissions: subtree read on dc=corp,dc=internal including sensitive attributes
config.kafka_topic_acl: any authenticated principal can produce to user-sync-events
